title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（赤坂剛史研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Akasaka Takeshi)
educationalGoal: Based on the design and fabrication technology of the basics of aeronautical engineering learned so far, a basic ability to design, fabricate and propose feasible ideas on transportation machines by application of aeronautical engineering theory will be obtained. At the same time, students will learn the importance of cooperation with society (community in particular) to advance their ideas.
advice:
Specific project themes will be determined through discussion, and problems will be discovered and resolved according to these discussions. Themes can be broadly classified as follows.

(1) Rotary wing such as high speed helicopter and propeller
(2) Design and control system such as drone and eVTOL
(3) Airborne wind turbine
(4) Flexible wing such as parachute and paraglider
requiredKnowledge: Because Design Project III is based on lectures, experiments, and practice of quarters 1-6 in the department of aeronautics, students must review them appropriately as needed.

activityGoals.body: Be able to establish a project theme and put it into action based on an engineering design process.
Be able to finalize the results students obtained in documents and conduct the presentation.
Be able to perform design, drafting, manufacturing (production) and simulation.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1)	Student clearly understands the purpose and the promotion process of the project theme and can achieve annual objectives that suit this purpose.
(2)	Students prepare an interim result of the project as an interim report and present and discuss it. Students prepare their research result as a final report and make a presentation and discuss it in an open presentation and evaluation meeting. In addition, students can report this final result in the scientific journal relating to their major subject and can receive outside evaluation.
(3)	Students conduct design and production activities on their own as needed and can evaluate their performance.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1)	Student clearly understands the purpose and the promotion process of the project theme and can achieve annual objectives that suit this purpose.

(2) Students should prepare an interim result of the project as an interim report and present it. Students prepare the final result as a final report and present it in an open presentation and evaluation meeting.
